plan.notes: Source: official UWSP Sample Graduation Plan, Department of Sociology and Social Work (online track). The plan states it 'is not meant to serve as an official document' and refers students to their adviser and the University Catalog (https://catalog.uwsp.edu/). No catalog year printed; filed under 2026-2027 as the current catalog at collection time. SOURCE INCONSISTENCY: the courses listed for Semester 6 sum to 16 credits but the plan prints 'Total credits 15' for that semester, and the printed semester subtotals sum to 121 while the plan prints 'Total credits 120'; every listed course is modeled as printed, giving a modeled total of 122. Courses marked * are offered online only during the semester indicated. 'Elective or second major, minor, or certificate course' slots modeled as free electives. Apply for acceptance into the Social Work Program during Semester 3; apply for Social Work Field Placement during Semester 6. Prerequisites not listed on the plan; see the catalog.
